This is just a sneak peek but I'll tell you it's another crazy FPP because you know I can't just design a HST simple block and because I believe in designing what I like and not what's easy for someone else to make. Saawrry!  But let me clear things up because I know how our IG relationship is sensitive and we all take things personal I love HST's. This is not an attack on anyone. Some of my favorite designs are HST's. It's just that my mind doesn't think that way. That's all.
